reply.text: {"say":"Chest leads with a flat bench, an incline press and a cable fly, then exactly two shoulder movements to finish: an overhead press and lateral raises.","title":"Chest & Shoulders","days":[{"name":"Chest & Shoulders","exercises":[{"key":"barbell-bench-press","sets":4,"reps":6,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Pause briefly at the chest"},{"key":"dumbbell-incline-bench-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"30-degree incline"},{"key":"machine-chest-press","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Slow lowering, full stretch"},{"key":"cable-crossover","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Squeeze hands together at the finish"},{"key":"seated-dumbbell-shoulder-press","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":10,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Stop just short of lockout"},{"key":"dumbbell-lateral-raise","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Lead with the elbows"}]}],"unmet":[]}
